issues.t: ABS may lock the rear brakes (recall)
issues.sym: The rear wheels lock up or skid during hard or slippery-road braking.
issues.why: Software in the anti-lock brake control unit could let the rear brakes lock instead of modulating them.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 06V-493 and have the ABS unit reprogrammed. Brake gently and leave extra distance until it is done.

issues.t: Sticking accelerator pedal (recall)
issues.sym: The gas pedal is slow to come back up or stays partly pressed after you lift your foot.
issues.why: Pivot bushings in the accelerator pedal assembly can work loose and make the pedal bind.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 10V-234. If the pedal sticks, shift to neutral, brake to a stop and have the car towed.

issues.t: Engine computer may crack and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine suddenly stalls or will not restart, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: Adhesive used when building the powertrain control module could crack its circuit board.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 08V-528 and have the module replaced. A stall in traffic is dangerous, so do not put it off.

issues.t: Seatbelt tensioner and side airbag timing error (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning; some vehicles show an airbag light.
issues.why: A software error in the occupant restraint system could delay or stop the seatbelt tensioners and side airbags from firing in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 13V-233 and have the software updated.

issues.t: Airbag control module may short out (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light comes on and stays on.
issues.why: The occupant restraint control module could short internally, switching off the airbags and seatbelt tensioners.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 16V-668. If the airbag light is on, have it diagnosed promptly; the airbags may not work in a crash.

issues.t: Steering column rivet may be missing (recall)
issues.sym: Looseness or play in the steering column, or the tilt column not feeling solid.
issues.why: A pivot rivet in the steering column could be missing or out of place, which could let the column separate.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 11V-315. Have any loose-feeling steering inspected before driving further.

issues.t: Fuel tank rollover valve damage (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell or wet spots under the rear of the vehicle.
issues.why: The rollover valve on the fuel tank could be damaged during manufacturing, allowing fuel to leak.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 12V-142. If you smell fuel, park outside away from flames and have the tank replaced before driving.

issues.t: Fuel transfer tube may cause stalling (recall)
issues.sym: The engine sputters or stalls when the fuel gauge shows fuel left, often below half a tank.
issues.why: A defective transfer tube inside the fuel tank could stop moving fuel to the pump side.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 13V-120 and have the tube replaced. Keep the tank fuller than usual until it is done.

issues.t: Balance shaft debris can cut oil pressure (recall)
issues.sym: The oil pressure warning comes on, the engine gets noisy, or it stalls.
issues.why: Abrasive debris left in the balance shaft bearings could cause a loss of oil pressure and engine damage.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 13V-552. Stop the engine right away if the oil pressure light comes on.

issues.t: Power steering return hose can come off (recall)
issues.sym: Power steering fluid leaking or a burning smell, steering that suddenly gets heavy, or a whining pump.
issues.why: A hose clamp was put in the wrong place, so the power steering return hose could slip off and spray fluid.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 15V-878. Do not drive if fluid is leaking near hot engine parts; have the clamp repositioned.

issues.t: Crank or cam sensor may stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls while driving or will not start, sometimes coming back after a few tries.
issues.why: A poor connection at the crankshaft or camshaft position sensor could make the signal drop out.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 16V-907 and have the connector replaced. Avoid heavy traffic until it is repaired.

issues.t: Left front axle shaft may separate (recall)
issues.sym: Clicking or clunking from the front left, or a sudden loss of drive power.
issues.why: On some vehicles with the 6-speed transmission, the left front half shaft could come out of place or break.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 17V-301. Stop driving and have the vehicle towed if you lose drive or hear a sudden clunk.

issues.t: Gauge lights cannot be dimmed (recall)
issues.sym: The instrument cluster stays bright at night and the dimmer does nothing.
issues.why: Software in the instrument cluster did not allow the backlighting to be dimmed, which can cause glare at night.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 17V-740 and have the software updated.

issues.t: Excessive oil consumption
issues.sym: The low oil warning comes on between changes, you keep needing to add oil, or you see blue smoke or fouled spark plugs. Severe cases can stall.
issues.why: The piston oil control rings may not seal well, letting the engine burn oil. A class action settlement extended powertrain coverage for eligible vehicles.
issues.next: Check the oil at every fill-up and ask a dealer for an oil consumption test and whether extended coverage applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Cracked oil pump housing (recall)
issues.sym: The oil pressure warning comes on, or the engine gets noisy and then stalls.
issues.why: The oil pump housing on some engines can crack, causing a loss of oil pressure.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 17V-670. Stop the engine right away if the oil pressure light comes on.

issues.t: Passenger airbag mounting nuts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning; some vehicles show an airbag light.
issues.why: The nuts that hold the passenger airbag inflator may not have been tightened, so the airbag might not deploy correctly in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 17V-732 and have the passenger airbag module replaced.

issues.t: Front lower control arm weld defect (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk from the front suspension, or the vehicle pulling or wandering.
issues.why: Some front lower control arms were not welded correctly and could separate, which affects steering control.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 18V-279. Have any front clunk or wander inspected before driving further.

issues.t: Engine computer chip failure (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls while driving or will not start, often with warning lights.
issues.why: A chip inside the powertrain control module could fail.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 18V-524 and have the module replaced. Do not rely on the vehicle in traffic if it has stalled.

issues.t: Reduced rear braking (recall)
issues.sym: A soft or long brake pedal, or stopping distances that seem longer than normal.
issues.why: A coating problem on the rear brake caliper pistons can let gas pockets form in the brake system. The recall bleeds the brakes.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 18V-523 and have it done promptly. Have a soft pedal checked before relying on the vehicle.

issues.t: Windshield wiper arms may loosen (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers skip, stop short, or one arm flops while the motor runs.
issues.why: The nuts holding the wiper arms could loosen, so the wipers may not clear the windshield.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-208 and have the nuts tightened. Avoid driving in heavy rain or snow until it is fixed.

issues.t: Loose front head restraints (recall)
issues.sym: A front headrest feels loose or moves even when locked in place.
issues.why: The front head restraints may not have been welded properly, so they may not protect your head and neck as designed in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-248 and have both front head restraints replaced.

issues.t: Instrument cluster too dim or not adjustable (recall)
issues.sym: The gauge display is hard to read in daylight, or its brightness will not change.
issues.why: A display that was too dim on some 2022 models, and body control software that blocked brightness adjustment on 2022-2023 models, can make warnings and speed hard to see.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 23V-058 and 23V-576 and have the cluster or software fixed.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not show (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank or frozen when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: Radio software can stop the rearview camera picture from displaying.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 24V-436 and get the software update at a dealer or over the air. Use mirrors and look behind you until it is fixed.

issues.t: Backup camera image may not show (recall)
issues.sym: The screen stays blank or does not switch to the camera view when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A radio software fault can keep the rearview camera picture from appearing.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 26V-531 and get the radio software update. Use mirrors and look behind you until it is fixed.
